title: Adapter
description: What runs Naive on a platform or in an agent harness (Z-4), as a Next.js adapter customizes build and deploy for a platform. A harness adapter (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) adapts the framework through the venture's AGENTS.md and skills: the entry files it writes into a venture, and where it puts the package skills. A platform adapter (Mentura, Naive's first, as Vercel is for Next.js) names the tests it runs. An adapter is verified when it passes the framework's tests (node interface/adapters.mjs verify <name>). Harness adapters are interface/adapters/<name>.json; the platform's is platform/adapter.json.

reads.description: The files the harness or platform reads on its own, as globs

files.description: Entry files the adapter writes into a venture; each must lead to the venture's AGENTS.md

skills.description: The folder the harness loads skills from; each open package's skill is copied to <folder>/<skill id>/SKILL.md. null when the harness reaches skills through AGENTS.md

verify.description: A platform adapter: the test programs it must pass, each run as node <path> and ending with all passing or exit 0

sources.description: Where the harness documents what it reads
